grades.quote: To ensure that implicit reads observe writes to the same memory locations, an SFENCE.VMA instruction must be executed after the writes to flush the relevant cached translations.
grades.reason: This is generic RISC-V background rather than xv6. It explains that translations may be held in an address-translation cache, tagged by the ASID loaded from satp. It also says SFENCE.VMA must be executed after page-table changes to flush stale cached translations. That partly supports why SFENCE.VMA is needed, but it never ties this to a satp switch or to xv6 user trap entry.
